subject: Custom SLA & support packaging for Applifin — pricing flexibility request
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@applifin.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@applifin.com>
Date: 2027-07-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SLA options + discount for reserved commit

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team liked Redwood's predictable latency and the autoscale behavior. We're looking at committing to a 12–24 month reserved pool but Procurement pushed back on the support uplift cost.

Specific ask: can you share a clear matrix for uptime tiers, response windows (P1/P2/P3), and the incremental discount if we commit to a 12-month vs 24-month reserved plan? Also curious if you offer a blended credit for incidents (we prefer credits over refunds).

We're on a tight timeline for our Q4 rollout so a concise options table + ballpark pricing would help move this quickly.

Cheers,
Alyssa
Alyssa Park
Head of Platform Engineering
Applifin Systems

Attachments: applifin-usage-forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@applifin.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SLA options + discount for reserved commit

Alyssa — thanks for the note and the forecast. I've attached a short term-sheet that lays out the options. High level: we can offer three support packages (Standard, Priority, Premier) with defined uptime targets and response SLAs. Pricing/discounts are tied to committed GPU-months and contract length.

Quick summary (details in attached PDF):
- Standard: 99.5% uptime, P1 4h, P2 8h, P3 48h. No credits for incidents (base support).
- Priority: 99.9% uptime, P1 2h, P2 4h, P3 24h. Includes incident credits (pro-rata tokens) and one on-call escalation per month.
- Premier: 99.95% uptime, P1 1h, P2 2h, P3 12h. 24/7 engineering escalation, quarterly review, and accelerated auto-rollbacks.

Discounts we can consider: 10% off list for 12-month commit, 16% for 24-month, plus a one-time onboarding credit for higher-tier commits. We can also trade a small additional discount in exchange for a 6-month ramp and an early payment term.

Looping in Ben (pricing lead) and Rishi (product pricing) to flesh options and produce the balled table for Procurement. I'll flag items we can't move on (e.g., reducing P1 below 1h for Premier).

Best,
Sofia
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-07-21-SLA-term-sheet.pdf (term sheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-22T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: FW: SLA options + discount for reserved commit — pricing scenarios

Sofia / Rishi — quick pass from pricing. I drafted three commercial scenarios that are intentionally easy for Procurement to compare. Putting them below; I'll attach a short one-pager as well.

Scenario A — Committed 12 months (mid-entry):
- Tier: Priority
- Uptime: 99.9%
- Response: P1 2h / P2 4h / P3 24h
- Discount: 12% off hosted list (applies to token & GPU unit pricing)
- Incident credit: 8% credit on affected billing month for verified downtime beyond SLO
- Onboarding: 40 hours of migrations + 1 week of health-checks included

Scenario B — Committed 24 months (value):
- Tier: Priority -> Premier upgrade path after 9 months if usage >= forecast
- Uptime: 99.9% / upgrade to 99.95% for Premier
- Response: P1 1.5h (avg) / P2 3h / P3 18h
- Discount: 18% off hosted list + 10% additional on support fees
- Incident credit: 12% credit on affected month
- Onboarding: 80 hours migrations + dedicated Solutions Engineer for 3 months

Scenario C — Pure Premier (short term):
- Tier: Premier
- Uptime: 99.95%
- Response: P1 1h / P2 2h / P3 12h
- Discount: 8% off list for 12-months (higher support premium retained)
- Incident credit: 15% credit; allowed up to 3 incidents per year before contract review
- Additional: Option to buy retainer hours (5h/mo) at discounted rate for guaranteed triage

Notes:
- Credits are preferencing token/billing credits instead of cash refunds per Alyssa's request.
- We should retain a clause limiting credits to verified infrastructure-related SLO misses (not app-level issues).
- Need legal to confirm change to support fee treatment and the upgrade path language.

I'll prep a clean term-sheet for Sofia to send out. Thoughts?

-ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales — Redwood Inference

Attachment: scenario-one-pager.pdf (summary)

From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@applifin.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@applifin.com>
Date: 2027-07-27T10:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Custom SLA & support packaging for Applifin — pricing flexibility request

Sofia — thanks to you and the team for the quick turnaround. The three scenarios are helpful. Procurement prefers Scenario B (24 months) but has two asks before we go to legal: 1) can the 18% discount be applied to the committed baseline only (not burst overage)? 2) can incident credits be capped at 20% of a single month's committed spend to avoid runaway credits?

If you can confirm those two points we'll route this to Legal + Procurement for signature next week. Also, can we get the term-sheet as a single PDF with the finalized numbers and a DocuSign link?

Best,
Alyssa

On Wed, Jul 21, 2027 at 11:03 AM Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alyssa — thanks for the note and the forecast. I've attached a short term-sheet that lays out the options...

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-29T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Custom SLA & support packaging for Applifin — confirm modifications

Ben / Sofia / Rishi — Legal is okay with both asks with minor edits:
- Discount scope: 18% applies to committed baseline usage only; burst overage billed at standard rates. Language added to term-sheet.
- Credit cap: incident credits capped at 20% of that month's committed billing (per Alyssa's request). If cumulative credits exceed 40% in a rolling 12-month window, we will do a contract review (standard remediation clause).

I've updated the term-sheet and generated a DocuSign envelope. Sending to Sofia to confirm numbers before I route to Alyssa & Procurement.

Next steps for Sofia: attach updated PDF and send DocuSign link to Applifin + CC Procurement.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2027-07-29-SLA-term-sheet.pdf (updated)
